attempts.summary: Configured persistent NFS sharing from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. Both systems use dataops UID/GID 4500; the directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770. Bidirectional files retain 4500:4500 ownership and mode 660. Both nodes were restarted individually and fully recovered with changed boot IDs. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remain unchanged.
